name: Hockenheimring
notes: 1991 long GP circuit (clockwise): Motodrom, Nordkurve, forest straight, Ostkurve chicane, return straight, Agip/Sachs/Suedkurve. The forest section follows OSM's abandoned:highway=raceway ways (Streckenverlauf 1932-2001); the Nordkurve exit onto the forest straight is bridged (no longer in OSM). Includes all three 1991 chicanes: Jim Clark (1970), Ostkurve (1982) and the return-straight chicane (1970, named Senna-Schikane only from 1994; OSM's 1994 geometry is used). The 1991 return straight ran straight from the Senna chicane exit into today's run to the Agip-Kurve (way 15444543); the missing ~500 m in between are bridged as a straight line (today's quarter-mile drag strip runs ~50 m south of it and is not used). Excluded: today's Parabolika/Spitzkehre layout incl. its back section (117570507) and the chicane-less Ostkurve. Traced 6716 m vs 6797 m in 1991. Overview: the area east of the Motodrom that was cleared for the 2002 rebuild is drawn as forest again (historic_forest), and the old forest section gets a cleared verge.
